parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of same-sex conduct or trans expression, and no documented border, facility, custody or care exclusion of trans visitors. The worst documented feature is tier 3: societal hostility, including Pride-period assaults and threats, with thin recourse. Official condemnation was delayed and uneven, and hate-crime frameworks are weak and rarely enforced. Bias counts (17 and 25) lack denominators and cannot show per-capita risk. Violence is under-recorded, so no trend can be stated. Civil-society victim support exists but is not a visitor-facing remedy. Local-jurisdiction disclosure was abolished, a resident-facing change with little visitor relevance. Partnership-regime facts are unresolved and not rated. Overall: reduced risk, held below the acceptance-with-protections tier by unenforced protections and unquantified violence.
